**💰 Cost Overview**
The current cost is $81.8 over the past 5 days, projecting to $490.8 monthly.

**📈 Key Insights**
• EC2 instances are the largest cost driver, accounting for approximately 61% of total spend.
• Amazon S3 comprises roughly 23% of the total cost.
• Lambda functions contribute approximately 11% to the total cost.

**🎯 Top 3 Recommendations**
1. Analyze EC2 instance usage patterns and identify opportunities to rightsize instances or leverage reserved instances or savings plans for sustained usage.
2. Review S3 storage configurations to identify unused or infrequently accessed data and implement lifecycle policies to move data to cheaper storage tiers (e.g., Glacier, Deep Archive).
3. Optimize Lambda function execution time and memory allocation to reduce compute costs and explore provisioned concurrency if needed.
